title: My Year-End Bonus Dropped From 800K to 19K
originalTitle: 我年终奖80w降到1w9，领导却慌了
description: An AI-generated comic-style Chinese workplace-revenge microdrama (我年终奖80w降到1w9，领导却慌了) following Cheng Yan, an eight-year company veteran whose annual bonus is abruptly slashed from 800,000 to 19,000 yuan.
descriptionMore: Forced out of his job, Cheng Yan uncovers manipulated records and a conspiracy reaching senior executives, turning his fight for the truth into a high-stakes corporate revenge story. DataEye tracked a 1.128-billion-view increase for the series on Douyin in August 2026, ranking it third on the platform's monthly AI-drama chart.
